detail: IPUMS CPS extract cps_00001.dat; supplied extract codebook dated 2026-10-13. Original data remain unchanged.
https://cps.ipums.org/ ; https://cps.ipums.org/cps/citation.shtml
Hispanic/Latino civilians age 18+ of any race. Mexican origin is an overlapping subset, not Mexican-born status. Do not add populations.
Basic Monthly only (ASECFLAG != 1). Complete available history within configured year bounds. October 2025 is absent in this extract; do not fill missing months with zero.
Pooled 2019 observations weighted by EARNWT for earnings and WTFINL for labour force. Weight totals divided by 12 are average monthly totals. Counts are person-month observations.
Nominal USD. Monthly equivalents = usual gross weekly earnings * 52/12. These are neither net disposable budgets nor actual calendar-month earnings. No inflation adjustment.
Employed adult wage/salary workers in MISH 4/8, positive EARNWT, valid EARNWEEK2. Includes part-time and temporarily absent workers. Excludes self-employed and unpaid family workers.
999999.99 is EARNWEEK2 NIU, not dollars. Valid zero earnings are retained. Nonworkers are excluded from conditional earnings, not assigned missing-code dollars.
Use codebook field widths and implied decimals: EARNWEEK2 /100; EARNWT and WTFINL /10000. Applied once to raw fixed-width integers.
https://cps.ipums.org/cps-action/variables/EARNWEEK2 ; https://cps.ipums.org/cps/outgoing_rotation_notes.shtml
OCC2010 harmonized codes, not IND industry. Crosswalk shows all code labels and assignments. Unknown jobs retained separately. Working student/pensioner cannot be identified from this extract.
Weighted U/(E+U), with current occupation for employed and last reported occupation for unemployed. New entrants/unassignable jobs remain Unknown. Employment counts include self-employment.
Overall employment/population and participation use all adult civilians. Occupation-specific NILF denominators are not used because past occupation coverage is incomplete.
https://cps.ipums.org/cps-action/variables/EMPSTAT ; https://cps.ipums.org/cps-action/variables/OCC ; https://cps.ipums.org/cps-action/variables/WTFINL

Direct standardization within each population/job to 2019 joint age (18-34/35-54/55+), sex and education (<=high school / some college+) earnings-weight shares. Does not remove unobserved selection or finer occupational shifts.

Cell mean requires n>=3; supported baseline mass must be >= 90%. Otherwise adjusted earnings blank. Supported shares renormalized; coverage exported. Unknown demographic cells excluded from reference.
Reliable flag requires raw n>=30 and Kish effective n>=20. Effective n reflects unequal weights only, not full survey-design variance.
Reliable flag requires labour-force n>=100 and unemployed n>=5. Raw rates retained even when flagged. No design-based standard errors or confidence intervals.

Unknown often consists of unassignable unemployed/new entrants and nonparticipants, with no employed denominator. Its rate can be 100% by construction. Diagnostic only: never use it as a migrant job-loss probability.

Pre-April 2023 fixed topcode share measures earnings >=2884.61. Later values blank because dynamic/phased topcoding is not reconstructed. Public-use topcodes retained; means are not topcode-corrected.

Official EMPSTAT used without speculative reclassification. Early-2020 temporary-absence misclassification can understate unemployment. https://www.bls.gov/blog/2020/update-on-the-misclassification-that-affected-the-unemployment-rate.htm

2019 MISH4 earners linked by CPSIDV and calendar month to MISH8 in 2020. Quartiles from pooled 2019 earnings in each population. Boundary ties go to lower quartile; categories need not contain exactly 25%.
Origin EARNWT only, no longitudinal/attrition weights. Matched-sample descriptive rates, not population unemployment estimates. Coverage and sample flags exported; use_for_abm is False.
https://cps.ipums.org/cps-action/variables/CPSIDV ; https://cps.ipums.org/cps/cps_linking_documentation.shtml
Read baseline_2019 for static inputs and monthly_earnings/monthly_employment for time paths. Join by population/job_group/year/month. Check quality flags; never silently replace missing with zero.
Earnings are gross upper bounds, not remittable disposable income. Unemployment rates are stocks, not job-loss probabilities. Do not simulate unemployment and also multiply employed earnings by 1-u.
Edit Python dictionaries/settings, then rerun script. Workbook cells are materialized analysis outputs for reliable pandas reading; Excel edits do not rerun microdata analysis.
